about.heading: about
paragraphs: placeholder is a weekly email event calendar of unique events happening in san francisco.
we're run by a small team that hand picks local, in-person events that seek to provide meaningful experiences to those who attend.

curation.heading: curation
paragraphs:
we're just starting out but expect the unexpected as well as the expected. our focus will be on both large and small outings that 
are free or relatively inexpensive. we will typically not post concerts, club events,

subscribing.heading: subscribing
paragraphs: we only use your email to send you placeholder events once a week, nothing else.
your information is stored into a private database which is accessed by our mailer, nothing else.
